title: New Thickened Plastic Flower Pot With A Bottom Tray
body_html:
Overview:
This thickened plastic flower pot is designed for plants like Pothos and succulents, featuring a self-watering irrigation system with a tray base to maintain soil moisture and prevent water accumulation. Its anti-deformation structure and blow-molding process ensure durability, making it suitable for balconies and home offices.

Specification:
Material: Plastic
Colour: Style 1 White [5-piece set], Style 1 Black [5-piece set], Style 1 Green [5-piece set], Style 2 White [5-piece set], Style 2 Black [5-piece set], Style 2 Green [5-piece set]
Installation Type: Floor-standing
Application Scenario: Office
Features: Anti-deformation
Craft: Blow molding
